source_docs.title: ICH E2C(R2) Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report (PBRER)
EU GVP Module VII - Periodic safety update report (Rev 1), EMA/816292/2011 Rev 1

notes: Titles and order come from the recommended table of contents in E2C(R2) 2.9.2. Clause 3.N gives the content of PBRER section N (E2C(R2) section 3, first paragraph).
Region 'ich' entries apply everywhere. Region 'eu' entries come from GVP Module VII and apply only to a region='eu' check.
Aliases hold the GVP Module VII wording of the same section, so an EU PSUR heading matches its ICH entry.

sections.title: Title Page
sections.note: Unnumbered heading in E2C(R2) section 3, before 3.1. GVP VII.B.5 ('PSUR title page'): in the EU the title page also contains the signature (EU-specific requirement).

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.note: Unnumbered heading in E2C(R2) section 3. It summarises exposure from section 5; the exposure figures stay in section 5 with the marker.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.note: Q&A 4.2: how to determine the IBD.

sections.title: Actions Taken in the Reporting Interval for Safety Reasons
Changes to Reference Safety Information
sections.note: Spec section 6 routes this section to the current-label lookup plus a change-history gap. The clean reference document itself is Appendix 1.

sections.title: Estimated Exposure and Use Patterns
sections.note: Q&A 6.2: state in section 5 the countries where use is off-label.

sections.title: Cumulative Subject Exposure in Clinical Trials
sections.note: Q&A 7.1: give a best estimate with its basis when precise exposure data are not available.

sections.title: Cumulative and Interval Patient Exposure from Marketing Experience
sections.note: Q&A 7.2: sources and limitations of post-marketing exposure data. Q&A 2.3: off-label use goes in paragraph 3 (other post-approval use).

sections.title: Reference Information
sections.note: Content: the version(s) of the coding dictionary the MAH used for its tabulations. Same title as Appendix 1; a heading without a number resolves to the next unmatched entry in order.

sections.title: Cumulative Summary Tabulations of Serious Adverse Events from Clinical Trials
sections.note: Q&A 8.1, 8.2, 8.3: which SAEs the tabulation includes (interventional trials, comparator use, non-MAH-sponsored studies).

sections.title: Cumulative and Interval Summary Tabulations from Post-Marketing Data Sources
sections.note: Q&A 8.4: tabulate events, not case reports.

sections.title: Summaries of Significant Findings from Clinical Trials during the Reporting Period
sections.note: Title from the 2.9.2 table of contents. The 3.7 heading reads 'Summaries of Significant Safety Findings from Clinical Trials during the Reporting Interval'.
aliases: Summaries of Significant Safety Findings from Clinical Trials during the Reporting Interval
Summaries of significant findings from clinical trials during the reporting interval

sections.title: Other Therapeutic Use of Medicinal Product
sections.note: Q&A 9.2: expanded access, compassionate use and other protocol-driven programmes, and trials in other therapeutic uses.

sections.title: New Safety Data Related to Fixed Combination Therapies
Information from Other Clinical Trials and Sources
Other Clinical Trials
sections.note: Not in the 2.9.2 table of contents, but 3.9.1 gives its content, Q&A 9.1 names 'Section 9.1 (Other Clinical Trials)' and GVP VII lists it. Q&A 9.1: briefly summarise co-development partner and investigator-initiated trial findings here.

sections.title: Medication Errors
sections.note: Not in the 2.9.2 table of contents; 3.9.2 gives its content and GVP VII lists it.

sections.title: Non-Clinical Data
sections.note: Q&A 10.1: all non-clinical studies of the interval, whoever sponsored them.

sections.title: Literature
sections.note: Q&A 11.1, 11.2: scope of the literature section and of the literature search.

sections.title: Other Periodic Reports
sections.note: Content: the MAH's other PBRERs for the substance and periodic reports received from partners under contract. Only the MAH holds them.

sections.title: Lack of Efficacy in Controlled Clinical Trials
sections.note: Q&A 12.1: not limited to controlled trials. Q&A 12.2: scope of 'serious or life-threatening illnesses'.

sections.title: Overview of Signals: New, Ongoing, or Closed
sections.note: Q&A 13.3: a topic monitored at an authority's request and not judged a signal is summarised here. Q&A 2.3: signals from all uses, off-label included.
aliases: Overview of signals: new, ongoing or closed

sections.title: Signal and Risk Evaluation
sections.note: Q&A 13.2: how to avoid repeating data across sections 6 to 16.

sections.title: Summary of Safety Concerns
sections.note: Q&A 13.4: safety concerns that differ by region.

sections.title: Evaluation of Risks and New Information
Characterisation of Risks
sections.note: Q&A 13.5: public health impact.

sections.title: Effectiveness of Risk Minimisation (if applicable)
sections.note: Required: section 3 says every section is completed and 'not applicable' is stated. Q&A 14.1: results that apply only to one region go in the regional appendix.

sections.title: Benefit Evaluation
sections.note: Q&A 15.1: meaning of efficacy and effectiveness.

sections.title: Important Baseline Efficacy/Effectiveness Information
sections.note: Q&A 15.2: points to consider for the baseline information.
aliases: Important baseline efficacy and effectiveness information

sections.title: Newly Identified information on Efficacy/Effectiveness
sections.note: Q&A 15.3, 15.4: what new information goes here; uses outside the approved indications.
aliases: Newly identified information on efficacy and effectiveness

sections.title: Integrated Benefit-Risk Analysis for Approved Indications
sections.note: Q&A 15.7: a benefit-risk evaluation against a local label goes in a suitable subsection or an appendix.
aliases: Integrated benefit-risk analysis for authorised indications

sections.title: Benefit-Risk Context - Medical Need and Important Alternatives
Benefit-Risk Analysis Evaluation
sections.note: Q&A 15.5: key risks and key benefits. Q&A 15.6: quantitative methods.

sections.title: Reference Information
sections.note: The clean reference document current at the DLP (3.4), for example the CCDS with its CCSI (2.4). Q&A 6.1: choosing the reference product information.

sections.title: Cumulative Summary Tabulation of Serious Adverse Events from Clinical Trials and Interval/Cumulative Summary Tabulations from Marketed Experience
Tabular Summary of Safety Signals
sections.note: Only if the signal table is not in the body of the report (3.20).

sections.title: Listing of Interventional and Non-Interventional Studies with a Primary Objective of Post-Authorization Safety Monitoring
List of the Sources of Information Used to Prepare the PBRER
sections.note: Only when desired by the MAH (3.20). Q&A 2.4 and guideline Appendix E: possible sources.

sections.title: Regional appendix
sections.note: GVP VII.B.5.20 item 6; content in VII.C.5. E2C(R2) 3.20 allows regional appendices but does not require one.

sections.title: Proposed product information
sections.note: Proposals for the SmPC and package leaflet, from the conclusions of the PSUR, with a brief description of ongoing procedures. The current SmPC is public.

sections.title: Proposed additional pharmacovigilance and risk minimisation activities
Summary of ongoing safety concerns
sections.note: Table 'Summary - Ongoing safety concerns' from the RMP version in effect at the start of the reporting interval. Only the MAH holds that RMP version.

sections.title: Reporting of results from post-authorisation safety studies
sections.note: Final study reports of the MAH's PASS completed in the interval, and the reasons for any study stopped. Only the MAH holds them.

sections.title: Effectiveness of risk minimisation
sections.note: Evaluation of routine and additional risk minimisation in the EU context. Q&A 14.1 sends region-specific results here.
